mechanics.claim: Riposte prevents all incoming non-turret damage during its parry window, but is not true invulnerability: life steal/heal based on damage still triggers and shields absorb before it applies.
mechanics.quote: ''Riposte'' does not grant {{tip|invulnerability}} but instead reduces any incoming damage by 100% late into the damage event.

mechanics.claim: The shock deals damage after a 0.5s poise, hitting all enemies in a line until it collides with an enemy champion.
mechanics.quote: sends a shock with her sword in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies hit until colliding with an enemy champion

mechanics.claim: If Riposte negates a hostile immobilizing effect, the target is stunned instead of slowed/crippled.
mechanics.quote: If ''Riposte'' negates at least one {{tt|hostile|Belonging to an enemy source}} {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect, '''Fiora''' {{tip|stun|stuns}} the target for the same duration instead.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts only after the Riposte effect (parry + shock) completes.
